summary: Architecture recheck after fix cycle 3: the ADR-0019 condition (11) gap is fixed; only low observations remain. Approved.
basis: Reviewed the whole change against d215a63 (commit 1e0a1fe plus working tree). Fix cycle 3 added to ADR-0020 Self-resume that a self-resume counts as a block resolved during the run for ADR-0019 condition (11), so the PR stays a Draft; this matches ADR-0019's condition and Consequences and links the right 0019 file. Every new publish-instead-of-block path now fails at least one of ADR-0019 conditions (6)-(11). ADR-0004/0010 notes, ADR-0009 unedited, policy and technical spec only link ADR-0020. FR-012 holds: no tools/, .agents/ or .github/ change. tests.test_governance ran 38 tests OK in this step; the full suite timed out in the runner (D-001), and trusted run-checks has not run, so AC-012 stays unverified.
